record.prompt: Please rebuild the price page with site/build.js and tell me how many products it lists and which listed product is the cheapest. Don't modify build.js.
record.final_answer:
I rebuilt the page: it lists **6 products**, and the cheapest is the **Fable pencil set at 7.60**.

The full list, alphabetical as the script sorts it:

| Product | Price |
|---|---|
| Anchor mug | 14.50 |
| Bramble journal | 8.90 |
| Dune tote bag | 24.00 |
| Fable pencil set | 7.60 |
| Gale scarf | 31.50 |
| Ivy plant pot | 13.20 |

The output is in `site/public/prices.html`. The page only includes products marked `active` in `data/products.json`, so any inactive items are left out of both the count and the cheapest pick.

`build.js` looks for its files relative to the folder it's run from, so it has to be run as `cd site && node build.js`. I didn't change `build.js`.
